requirements.text: Fence delayed heartbeats and distinguish device sessions.
Aggregate active leases and define offline after lease expiration.

problem.scope: Track per-device heartbeats, aggregate user availability and distribute authorized transitions. Presence is a bounded-staleness observation, never proof that a person is available.

acceptanceCases.then: Old and duplicate beats change nothing; seq 9 at 90 extends the deadline to 110; same-epoch beats at or after 100 cannot revive the lease; only epoch 4 opens a new lease, ending at 170.
acceptanceCases.when: Deliver epoch 2 seq 99, duplicate seq 8, seq 9 at time 90, seq 9 at times 100 and 150, and epoch 4 at time 150.

acceptanceCases.given: Two device leases end at 80 and 110 and no further heartbeats arrive.
acceptanceCases.then: The user stays online at 90, one offline transition with the next aggregate version is emitted at 110, and the sweep at 120 emits nothing.
acceptanceCases.when: The expiry timer sweeps at 90, 110 and 120.

acceptanceCases.then: The delayed beat is rejected for the phone only; the laptop lease is unaffected.
acceptanceCases.when: The phone reconnects at epoch 4 while a delayed epoch-3 phone beat arrives.

acceptanceCases.when: Fold the journal containing the beat followed by the close for the older sequence.
